title: Story 1.1 AC says 'topology + forwarding state in the hash' — the forwarding table is deliberately NOT hashed
detail: The AC's literal wording includes forwarding state in the hash; the implementation excludes the derived table (canon-consistent, documented, replay-equality still holds via the serialized topology). Spec text and implementation disagree on wording only.
recommended_fix: Amend the story-1.1 AC wording to 'topology in the hash; derived forwarding table excluded (pure function of topology)' so canon text matches the port.
